poses.caption: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands gently behind your head. Keep elbows back and chest open.
Bend your hips and knees until thighs are near parallel, keeping your feet flat and knees aligned with toes. Stand back up without pulling your neck.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1580 PRISONER SQUAT. TWO equal square cells side by side WIDE2:1 landscape same full body person camera scale FRONT-SIDE three-quarter view facing RIGHT. BODYWEIGHT NO equipment. BOTH hands gently behind HEAD fingers lightly touching/interlaced behind occiput, elbows spread outward/back chest open, no neck pulling. Same hands/elbows/head alignment BOTH poses. Feet SHOULDER width toes slightly outward full soles flat same position. LEFT START tall standing hips/knees extended soft ribs/pelvis stacked neutral spine. RIGHT BOTTOM squat hips BACK/DOWN thighs approximately PARALLEL FLOOR, both knees track toes, chest lifted torso moderate forward lean neutral long back neck aligned, heels planted. PRIMARY BOTH QUADRICEPS FRONT thighs RED ONLY: exposed lower front thigh fine red anatomy, upper covered FRONT thigh only soft DIFFUSE red tint over INTACT black shorts. No glute/hamstring/calf red. Plain fabric broad real folds NO radial stars or fibers/muscle lobes through fabric. Detailed fine grayscale other exposed anatomy realistic hands fingers proportions. Full opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK and BLACK MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH continuous hems seams no cutaways/transparency. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft shadows generous12percent margins full head outspread elbows hands and feet within EACH SQUARE uncropped. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference rendering STYLE ONLY ignore bench pushup/chest red. No text labels captions arrows extra people.
jobs.inspectionNote: Two prisoner squat candidates, four poses, two built-in calls. Hands behind head with elbows out, standing to near-parallel squat, flat feet and quadriceps red. Full opaque clothes and detailed grayscale exposed anatomy retained. Qualified hand/neck pressure, finger contact hidden behind head, depth, torso/neck alignment, knee tracking and cloth tint require human review.
